answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy comes from making identity costly but its proof cheap to verify. Each AI agent must post a slashable bond held by a bonded custodian; a fresh register-and-mint sybil herd pays that stake every time it mints an identity, and if any member is caught acting in genuine bad faith the bonded stake is burned. Verified agents accrue standing, so honest ones reach a solid cedar foothold while impostors stay on an unstable knoll, unable to climb the trust zenith without real collateral at risk.
